The '''Kintan strider''' was a ferocious creature with incredible self-healing abilities. Extinct on their homeworld of [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]], they were used as guard beasts by many [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] gangsters.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Kintan_strider.png|thumb|left|200px|A kintan strider dejarik piece.]]
Physically, these creatures were considered an ugly sight to behold, with notably bizarre features. Despite this appearance, Kintan striders were noted for ferocious, aggressive, and vicious behavior with a relentless blood-lust. Quick and agile, their exceptional healing capabilities made them formidable opponents, allowing them to survive seemingly mortal blows whereupon they swiftly recovered enough to bring like aggression to their attacker.<ref name="GORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

White-[[Color/Legends|colored]], with large shoulders and arms dragging nearly to the ground, striders commonly carried sticks and large poles to use for weapons and as implements for eating.

Kintan striders were represented in [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]] games with a [[Holomonster/Legends|holomonster]] playing piece. One of the piece's tactics was the [[kintan strider death gambit]].

==History==
Kintan striders were originally native to the [[Wannschok|Endless Wastes]] of Kintan. Their ferocity made them a respected adversary to generations of ancient [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] orders. On their homeworld, striders became extinct due to a combination of pollution and over-hunting. It proved to be one of the last creatures to have died at the hands of the Nikto on Kintan. The creatures had been transported, bred, and domesticated on other worlds long before their demise on Kintan, however, thus preserving the species offworld.<ref name="GORW" /> A large number of Kintan striders were preserved by being held in the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[The Tomb|prison]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref>[[Star Wars: The Old Republic|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'']]</ref>
